text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: LumaTech onboarding just requested our SOC2 report and temporary access to a slice of telemetry to validate retention/masking. They9d like to finish their review by end of week. Any concerns?
jon_security: We can share SOC2 attestation and a redacted evidence bundle. We must not hand over raw user-level logs. Ask for exact datasets they need.
rachel_legal: +1. Offer a DPA addendum and an access plan: scoped, time-limited, read-only, fully audited. We can preapprove a 7-day window if infra confirms controls.
maria_cs: They specifically mentioned "user-event stream" plus a few recent API request traces to confirm masking/retention. Want files within 3 business days.
jon_security: Traces are high risk. Options: (A) sanitized aggregated traces with PII stripped, (B) synthetic replay that demonstrates masking. Which do they prefer?
sam_infra: Infra can do either: (1) ephemeral-read-only role exposing only metadata & hashed IDs, or (2) export job that redacts payloads and drops fields. Export ETA ~48h after scope locked.
kevin_pm: Recommend we offer a 30-min walkthrough + redacted export. Walkthrough often removes the need for deep data access. I can host Thurs morning.
maria_cs: I'll ask if walkthrough + redacted export is sufficient. If they insist on sample traces, we'll run the export and provide a signed URL.
rachel_legal: I'll draft a DPA addendum and request their legal contact + list of processing activities. Flag the 7-day access window and logging/audit terms.
jon_security: Action list: (1) Maria confirm scope with LumaTech today; (2) Sam provide export field list & redact rules by EOD; (3) Rachel produce DPA draft; (4) Kevin pencil in walkthrough. Call out if you can9t meet EOD.
maria_cs: Pinging them now. @kevin_pm tentatively reserve Thurs 9am PT?
kevin_pm: Done, hold that slot.
sam_infra: Will post export snippet + redacted-fields shortly. Example command: 
```bash
redact-export --source=traces --drop-pii --hash-ids --since=2026-03-01 --out=lumatech-redacted.tar.gz
```
jon_security: I'll review the snippet for leakage and add audit requirements.
maria_cs: Thanks! I9ll update once they reply.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: security-prod at 2026-03-12T22:00Z. No infra changes expected to affect exports. :white_check_mark:
